Adjust text size while keeping the board and text area fixed. Range: 50% to 200%. Default: 100%. Larger settings automatically fall back to the original 100% range when all event text needs more room; reduce this if needed.
Enter #RRGGBB such as #203040. Use #RRGGBBAA for opacity such as #203040CC. Blank or invalid values keep the original background.
Enter #RRGGBB such as #FFFFFF for white. Applies to all board text. Blank or invalid values keep the original multicolor text.
Show only events with at least one price increase or decrease. Off by default. Hidden events do not use a display slot.
